scripts.dev: rm -f out/server.js && (shadow-cljs watch app server & (until [ -f out/server.js ]; do sleep 1; done; node out/server.js))
scripts.dev:local: rm -f out/server.js && (shadow-cljs -A:local watch app server & (until [ -f out/server.js ]; do sleep 1; done; node out/server.js))
scripts.build: shadow-cljs release app server && vite build
